{{Recipe}} | [[Cookbook:European cuisines|European Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Romania|Cuisine of Romania]] 

This is a traditional [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Romania|Romanian]] dish, generally served during all festive and special occasions. It consists of a combination of finely chopped [[Cookbook:beef|beef]] and root vegetables, folded in [[Cookbook:mayonnaise|mayonnaise]] and finished with pickled vegetable [[Cookbook:garnish|garnishes]]. The name suggests a French culinary influence as the word boeuf is old French for cow and several well know French dishes such as [[Cookbook:Beef Bourguignon|Beef Bourguignon]] still use the term. The dish is usually made up in large quantities for the whole party. It's eaten as a side dish/salad to fried meats or as an appetiser/entree. Slight differences exist in quantities and these vary according to taste. The recipe below is my mother's and grandmother's. It requires a home made mayonnaise, for which a recipe is included.

==Ingredients==

=== Salad ===
* 1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] (2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] 3 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:potato|potatoes]] (any variety, though some prefer red)
* 350 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (12 oz) [[Cookbook:carrot|carrots]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] in 1 cm cubes
* 350 g boiled [[Cookbook:beef|beef]], cut in 1 cm cubes
* 1 can of [[Cookbook:peas|peas]] or 300 g (10.5 oz) fresh peas
* 350 g pickled dill [[Cookbook:Pickle|gherkins]] (not too sweet and very firm), diced in 1 cm cubes

=== Mayonnaise ===
* 2 [[Cookbook:Hard Boiled Eggs|hard boiled eggs]], yolks removed
* 1 fresh egg yolk
* 250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] (8.5 oz) [[Cookbook:Canola Oil|canola]] or [[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable]] oil
* 1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]], juiced
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (5 ml) French [[Cookbook:mustard|mustard]]

=== Garnish ===
*Boiled [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg white]], sliced into long thin strips
*Gherkins, sliced into long thin strips
*Pickled [[Cookbook:Red Pepper|red peppers]], sliced into long thin strips
*[[Cookbook:Slicing|Sliced]] black [[Cookbook:olive|olives]]

==Procedure==

=== Salad ===

# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the potatoes gently in their skins until tender. Cool, then remove the skins.
# Boil the carrots until tender.
# Gently boil the beef for 1 hour.
# If using fresh peas, boil or [[Cookbook:Steaming|steam]] them well.
# [[Cookbook:Cube|Cube]] the potatoes, carrots, and beef about 5 mm across—essentially, everything should be about the size of the peas.
# Cut the gherkins very finely by cutting 3 mm (⅛ inch) thick slices and then cutting them at 3 mm intervals again along the length and width.
# [[Cookbook:Fold|Fold]] everything together gently. Do not season.

=== Mayonnaise ===

# [[Cookbook:beat|Beat]] the cooked egg yolks and the raw yolk until well mixed.
# Slowly add the oil while beating the eggs until they start to thicken and form a mayonnaise.
# Add the juice of the lemon and the mustard.

=== Assembly ===

# Reserve a small quantity of mayonnaise for garnish.
# Fold the rest of the mayonnaise into the cubed meat and vegetables, making a nice consistency where the ingredients are well covered in mayonnaise but not suspended in it.
# Season with [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] and [[Cookbook:pepper|pepper]]. 
# Place the salata de boeuf into one large or several smaller bowls. 
# Spread reserved mayonnaise over the top and garnish with the garnishes, arranging them in attractive shapes.
